entry.title: New: Resolution 252 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO ASSIST THE POLICE DEPARTMENT WITH EXPENSES RELATING TO THE 67TH ANNUAL HAWAI‘I STATE LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIALS ASSOCIATION CONFERENCE

Transfers $2,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 7)
